13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.visual_critic_note: Dark theme with intentional blue/orange source-target color coding, confident whitespace, and good radial proportions, but at-rest state shows uniformly dim edge spaghetti with no visual hierarchy — the design only reveals its craft on hover.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.encoding_integrity_note: Topological layout means most quantitative honesty checks (baseline, lie factor, dual-axis) are inapplicable; cluster positions are data-driven and tension math is correct (beta=1-tension), but data joins lack key functions making the chart brittle to updates, and the static hardcoded radius/width values limit robustness under real data substitution.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires `linkSelection.attr('d', line)` on every `input` event with no debounce or RAF, re-rendering all ~80 bundled paths continuously during drag; no other interaction traps apply as there are no transitions, no multi-view dispatch, no zoom scales, and no touch/mouse dual-handling.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.cognitive_load_note: Hierarchical edge bundling and hover-fade interaction manage 80-edge density well, but the resting state collapses into a central hairball that yields no insight without hovering — the visualization only becomes readable on interaction.
